groupBlockSystem: the unique nontrivial 3+3 block system of the local C3 x S3 six-state action
stateMeaning: which of the two residual points on the hinge line ac belongs to the state's high-release tetrad
action: migrate that active residual hinge point
reading: The canonical 3+3 imprimitivity system compresses first-step near-ovoid source selection from ten busy points (or four high-release points) to one block-selected hinge-residual source. The two-state controller retains the exact one-step topology-aware headroom guarantee on all 2,880 states.
boundary: The two-state controller is certified only on the near-ovoid entry stratum. After the first full migration the state generally leaves that stratum and the generic topology-aware policy resumes unless a separate controller is proved for the new orbit.
